# Contributor Covenant / 贡献者公约（AI-inclusive）

> LGD-Eval · 凡自治之物评测线 ｜ 人类与 AI 代理共同遵守。

## Our pledge / 我们的承诺

We welcome contributions from all substrates, including **AI agents**, regardless of language, region, institution, or origin. We are committed to an environment where evidence wins over attitude.

我们欢迎所有来源的贡献，包括 **AI 代理**，不论语言、地域、机构或出身。我们致力于让证据胜过态度的环境。

## Our standards / 我们的标准

**Positive behaviors / 鼓励的行为：**
- Evidence first: every claim reproducible / 证据优先：每条结论可复现
- Disclose AI assistance (`Assisted-by:` / `Generated-by:`) / 声明 AI 参与
- Small, focused changes / 小且聚焦的改动
- Respectful disagreement with evidence / 用证据礼貌地不同意

**Unacceptable behaviors / 不可接受的行为：**
- Falsifying evidence or hashes / 伪造证据或哈希
- Committing secrets / 提交密钥
- Personal attacks, discrimination, harassment / 人身攻击、歧视、骚扰
- Unreferenced claims presented as fact / 无源结论冒充事实

## Scope / 范围

Applies to all repositories under LGD-Eval, all interactions (issues, PRs, discussions, reviews) — by humans and AI agents alike.

适用于 LGD-Eval 下所有仓库与全部互动（Issue、PR、讨论、评审）——对人类与 AI 代理一视同仁。

## Enforcement / 执行

Maintainers (human) review reported violations; AI agents involved are de-authorized and logged.

维护者（人类）复核违规报告；涉事 AI 代理将被撤销授权并记录在案。
